quotes.name: Brenda Okoro
quotes.quote: The closeout is published, the renewal ordinance is transmitted, and the standard holds at 23 days. Renewal is council's call — I won't call it before they do.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: The closeout is on the record, the renewal draft is in the clerk's hands, and the 23-day standard holds — but renewal belongs to the council, and I will not call their vote before they do.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: The mood in West Oakland is slipping and the housing pressure is building — which is exactly why the queue does not stop while the paperwork goes to the record.
